Hi Vivian,

Thanks again for applying for the Product Manager role — I reviewed your materials and would love to set up a quick 20-minute initial phone/virtual screen to learn a bit more about your background and share next steps.

Are any of the following windows doable on your side? I listed each as PST and the equivalent in EET (I see your resume shows you're in Berlin):

- Option A — Mon, Jun 1, 2026 09:00–09:20 PST / Mon, Jun 1, 2026 18:00–18:20 EET
- Option B — Mon, Jun 1, 2026 11:00–11:20 PST / Mon, Jun 1, 2026 20:00–20:20 EET
- Option C — Tue, Jun 2, 2026 08:30–08:50 PST / Tue, Jun 2, 2026 17:30–17:50 EET

If none of those fit, tell me two 30-minute blocks (in your local time) that work this week and we can try to find overlap. Also let me know whether you prefer a phone call or Google Meet — either is fine; if phone, what number should I call?

Marissa (hiring manager) is cc'd and may join the call for a few minutes.

Thanks — brief next step aim is just the 20-minute sync.
